competing_explanation: The policy may have been updated, may distinguish standard from non-standard items, or may impose conditions that limit full refunds.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy for standard items provides a full-refund return window of 30 days, typically counted from delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: Counterfactual evidence shows the current policy specifies a different number of days, a different start point, or does not provide full refunds for standard items within that window.
